evidence.title: Varchive | Tools for building with AI

name: Varchive
summary: AI news digest biased toward design, plus a gallery of AI-assisted work and a list of tools for building with AI.
description: A curated feed of artificial intelligence news for designers, written by Cameron Moll: each item links to the source with a short editorial note, readable on the site, by email or as RSS. The gallery collects AI-assisted work submitted by others — websites, apps and interfaces — and a software section lists tools for building with AI.
contains: news digest of AI items with a design angle
software section of tools for building with AI
